svg.title: Three Core Seats, Two Scale Seats
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-three-to-five-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Three Core Seats, Two Scale Seats; subtitle: Keep accountable ownership explicit as annual service fees grow.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time; C means contractor. Conservative and Base use one FT plus two C, totaling three people. Scaled uses two FT plus three C, totaling five people. Each numeric value is one person; the final two seats belong only to the scaled pod.; caption: Core pod: $60,000 revenue / $15,000 net or $255,000 / $95,625. Scaled five-person pod: $450,000 revenue / $225,000 net.; stages: label: Founder and accountable operator; value: Core seat: one full-time operating owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own engagement decisions, treasury relationships, fee pricing, dispute resolution, and cash reconciliation. Review exception queues rather than delegating final ownership judgments to an automated matcher.; label: Records investigator; value: Core seat: one contractor researching owner evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain source provenance, entity histories, address matches, and duplicate controls. Access only assigned case records; return ambiguous matches with explicit evidence gaps instead of confident guesses.; label: Claims administrator; value: Core seat: one contractor managing submission completeness; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Prepare authorized claim packets, track treasury receipts, request missing evidence, and maintain aging reports. Never convert a status update into an unsupported promise about payment timing.; label: Delivery and queue manager; value: Scale addition: one full-time case operations lead; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Coordinate researcher capacity, evidence response times, handoffs, and receivable follow-up. Add this seat when measured backlog and collected-fee economics support ongoing payroll, not merely a larger prospect list.; label: Complex-case specialist; value: Scale addition: one contractor reviewing exceptional cases; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Handle documented entity succession, estate evidence, or jurisdiction-specific specialist work within their credentials. Escalate matters requiring licensed counsel instead of expanding administrative staff authority.
